hook.text: A customer designs a phone case at midnight. It's 3D-printed and shipped by morning. No inventory. Just demand.

buildup.text: On-demand manufacturing produces items only when ordered—eliminating inventory risk and enabling full customization.

discovery.text: It combines digital design, flexible manufacturing, and fast logistics to deliver custom products at near-mass speed.

twist.text: On-demand works for some products but not all. Complex assemblies and high-volume goods still need traditional lines.

climax.text: Shapeways and Xometry run on-demand manufacturing platforms—connecting customers to idle factory capacity worldwide.

punchline.text: Make it when they want it. Not before. Not after.
